method: Qualitative editorial ordering of the achieved results and current evidence; not statistically calibrated acceptance probabilities, external peer review, or a fresh full proof audit. Neighboring ranks can change after external review. Titles, artifact volume and green checks are not proxies for importance.
ranking_basis: substantive independent novelty over identified prior work
current scope, proof and presentation risks
scope: 15 existing manuscripts; stoc6–8 template-only excluded, ongoing unresolved c021 research and method-obstruction notes excluded

entries.reason_en: Matches the n^(k+1) exponent for every fixed k≥2, with binary strong connectivity; the queue/clock invariant is a substantive construction. Its remaining risk is the specialized extremal-automata scope.
entries.reason_zh: 对每个固定 k≥2 匹配 n^(k+1) 指数，并保留二元、强连通限制；队列与时钟不变量有实质构造内容。风险是问题仍较专门。

entries.reason_en: Decides the full current membership model and constructive realizability, including erasure and unbounded finite partitions. The O(S^13) algorithm needs a broad, independently checked explanation of the new SCC criterion.
entries.reason_zh: 解决现行模型的完整成员判定与构造性可实现性，处理擦除输出及未知数量的有限分段。O(S^13) 算法的 SCC 判据需要向广泛读者讲清并作外部复核。

entries.topic_en: Global Sidorenko inequality for a cycle family
entries.topic_zh: 环族的全局 Sidorenko 不等式
entries.reason_en: Resolves the full infinite family globally, beyond the source local question, with equality and optimal-exponent forcing. Strong mathematical technique, but broader algorithmic impact is less immediate.
entries.reason_zh: 把原先局部问题推进为整个无限环族的全局不等式，含等号与最优指数的强制性。数学方法较突出，算法层面的影响尚不直接。

entries.topic_zh: 与规模无关的非线性 discrepancy
entries.reason_en: Removes item-count dependence for the whole sparse-coverage model via a constructive nonlinear-to-linear bridge. The O(t³k³) parameter dependence is coarse and the general influence-sparse problem remains open.
entries.reason_zh: 对完整稀疏覆盖模型消除物品数依赖，并给出构造性非线性转线性桥梁；O(t³k³) 依赖较粗，未解决一般 influence-sparse 问题。

entries.topic_zh: 结构子类型判定的二次屏障
entries.reason_en: Fine-grained complexity and representation sensitivity fit STOC very well. The source itself credits the OV automata hardness; the added semantic encoding must justify an independent main-conference contribution.
entries.reason_zh: 细粒度复杂度与表示敏感性很符合 STOC；但 OV 自动机困难性已有前作，新增类型语义编码是否足够独立，是核心风险。

entries.reason_en: Dynamic algorithms and the path-procedure OMv obstruction are natural. Positive bounds charge affected circuit gates and restrict calls/decompositions; the general target is not fully resolved and earlier RSM update machinery is close.
entries.reason_zh: 动态算法及路径过程上的 OMv 障碍很自然；正面界依赖受影响电路规模、无环调用及固定分解，一般目标仍未完成，且与已有 RSM 更新机制接近。

entries.reason_en: A timely theoretical problem with careful parameter accounting. General LR(1) acceleration is missing, stack annotations are classical, and novelty against online NFA simulation is unresolved.
entries.reason_zh: 问题及时，参数计费较认真；但一般 LR(1) 加速未完成，栈标注有经典前作，与在线 NFA 模拟的区别仍待建立。

entries.reason_en: An exact graph-class hierarchy and clean collision inequality, but much of the construction/constants comes from prior work. The new technique is short and significance remains the main obstacle.
entries.reason_zh: 图类精确层级与碰撞不等式干净，但构造和常数与前作重合较多；新增技术较短，主要障碍仍是重要性。

entries.topic_zh: Octagon 与 APSP 的指数等价
entries.reason_en: Very good fine-grained topic fit, but reductions and classical normalization carry most of the result. The imported October 2026 APSP exponents are other authors' reported algorithms, not a new breakthrough of this manuscript.
entries.reason_zh: 题材很符合细粒度复杂度；但归约与经典规范化占主要部分，所引 2026 年 10 月 APSP 指数属于其他作者报告的算法，不是本稿的新突破。

entries.topic_zh: 带标记回文的语言编辑距离
entries.reason_en: A scoped matching upper/lower picture with witnesses, but limited to a narrow deterministic grammar subclass and built around Landau–Vishkin/LCE ideas. The general LR(1) target remains open.
entries.reason_zh: 限定子类有匹配上下界和见证，但文法类较窄，主要围绕 Landau–Vishkin/LCE 方法，一般 LR(1) 原题仍开放。

entries.topic_zh: 最大度二匹配中的建议鲁棒性
entries.reason_en: Exact consistency–robustness frontiers have clear online-algorithm meaning. Degree-two and cycle restrictions make the advance small compared with general matching questions.
entries.reason_zh: 一致性与鲁棒性精确前沿有清楚的在线算法意义，但最大度二及环的限制，使增量小于一般匹配问题。

entries.topic_zh: 三个通配符的通用部分环
entries.relative_tier_en: Very low for current STOC package
entries.relative_tier_zh: 当前 STOC 竞争力很低
entries.reason_en: A complete, exactly checkable existence witness to the stated question. The present contribution is one finite 512-cycle rather than a general construction, algorithmic framework or broad classification.
entries.reason_zh: 是原题完整、可精确核验的存在性见证；当前核心是一条有限 512 环，缺少一般构造、算法框架或广泛刻画。

entries.reason_en: Matching asymptotics in a specified sparse-cardinality regime, not the unrestricted original. Limited parameter regime and significance dominate the risk.
entries.reason_zh: 只在指定稀疏基数范围给出匹配渐近界，未解决无此限制的原题；参数范围和重要性是主要风险。

entries.topic_zh: 带证书的鲁棒滑雪租赁优化
entries.reason_en: Exact certificates and reproducibility are useful, but the broader target is unresolved and numerical-b polynomial time is not polynomial in log b. No major new online principle is established.
entries.reason_zh: 精确证书与复现有价值，但更广目标未解决，数值 b 的多项式时间并非 log b 多项式；尚未建立重要的新在线原则。

entries.reason_en: Precise three-outcome excursion formulas, but the general problem is unresolved and the present result is the most specialized of this pool.
entries.reason_zh: 三点分布偏离公式精确，但一般问题未解决，当前结果是这一批中最专门的。
